confirmed_findings.fix: Exactpositiveintlimits; pre-conversion78decimaldigitbound consistentwith256bitmagnitude policy. Canonical valid values/digests unchanged.

confirmed_findings.before_result: 2 failed; both loops issued a call after the simulated deadline

confirmed_findings.issue: Delayed wakeup could begin an additional owner retry or launchd read after the documented wait deadline.

confirmed_findings.boundary: Adds input type rejection only; accepted enum vocabulary unchanged.

confirmed_findings.claim: JSON Schema integral floats entered typed policy fields and could render decimal native port syntax.

confirmed_findings.claim: Malformed plan enum and digest types escaped as TypeError; numeric target addresses were coerced by IPv4Address.
confirmed_findings.compatibility: Closed action vocabulary and canonical valid serialization unchanged; no admission authority added.

confirmed_findings.claim: Array/object journal phase escaped the intended OwnerFailure recovery path as TypeError.

confirmed_findings.claim: Executor accepted activation reply with an effective strategy different from the reviewed action.

confirmed_findings.claim: Mock activation could accept wrong-profile/future approval, unknown network, stale endpoint/profile, missing retained-state metadata or unacknowledged unrestricted-source risk.

confirmed_findings.issue: First-match scalar regexes accepted duplicate/conflicting job identity; idle runtime accepted duplicate/conflicting state.
